amendments.summary: Part 1 'Air Quality' — prohibit indoor gas; require electric cooktops, ovens and heaters in new residential development

Part 1 Stormwater Management (dual occupancy OSD) and Transport and Parking (dual occupancy minimums); Part 3 Dwellings expanded to incorporate dual occupancy, Beecroft Heritage Precinct provisions moved to Residential Flat Buildings (5 Storeys)
